annotations.title: Plan what to do with idle USDC

description: Idle USDC to a reviewable plan in one call: operating cash = max(reserve_usd, daily_burn_usd × days), the surplus above it, a simulation of minting that surplus into GBLIN at NAV (fees read live from the vault, estimated exit value today, round-trip cost), the same simulation for a trial amount (100 USDC by default), the blockers (crash shield, redemption cooldown, ETH for the exit) and the tools to call after a human confirms. Reads only: nothing is executed and nothing is advised. GBLIN is crypto exposure (cbBTC, WETH, USDC), not cash and not yield.

daily_burn_usd.description: Average daily spend in USD. Operating cash = daily_burn_usd × days.

days.description: Days of spend to keep liquid (default 7, max 365).

reserve_usd.description: USD to keep liquid regardless of the burn rate; the larger of the two rules wins.

trial_usdc.description: Trial amount to simulate beside the surplus (default 100).

name: treasury.plan

as_of.description: Block and time the reads were taken at.

blockers.description: Reasons parking is not appropriate right now, if any.

inputs.description: The inputs as applied, with the defaults filled in.

market.description: NAV, ETH price, risk regime and crash shield status.

next.description: The tools to call after a human confirms.

operating_cash.description: USDC to keep liquid: max(reserve_usd, daily_burn_usd × days), with the runway in days.

park_candidate.description: True when no blocker applies. Not a recommendation.

simulation.description: Mint simulation for the surplus: shares, fees, exit value today, round-trip cost; or nothing_to_park.

trial.description: The same simulation for the trial amount.

wallet_state.description: USDC, GBLIN and ETH balances, gas health, redemption cooldown.
